summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Dynamic Full-Stack Software Engineer with {{experience}} of experience in building scalable, high-performance applications. Proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks like Angular, Node.js and Express. Expertise includes API design, performance optimization, secure coding practices, and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in collaborating with Agile teams to deliver innovative software solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.

items.title: Orion Innovation
lists: Designed and developed dynamic full-stack web applications using Angular 16, Angular Material, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
Built RESTful APIs serving data for over 500,000 concurrent users, ensuring seamless integration with JavaScript / Typescript - based front-end systems.
Spearheaded CI/CD implementation, reducing deployment cycle time by 30% and contributing to continuous improvement in Agile Scrum teams.
Resolved critical application issues, ensuring 100% uptime and enhancing user experience.
Improved database performance by optimizing SQL queries and boosting query response times, aiding analytics by increasing reporting speed by 20%.

items.title: Leanfolks IT Services
lists: Developed responsive MERN stack applications for in-house projects using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
Integrated real-time synchronization features using Firebase, enhancing data consistency across applications.
Created interactive UI/UX components, improving client satisfaction by 20%.
Participated in training sessions to strengthen technical expertise in web development technologies.

items.content: Acknowledged for consistent innovation, dedication, and collaborative spirit.
lists: I just wanted to express my gratitude for your innovative thinking. You always come up with unique solutions and are never afraid to take on tough challenges.
Your strong technical expertise and visionary approach truly distinguish you. Your ability to foresee future needs and implement scalable solutions has been a tremendous asset to the team.
Nominating for his extraordinary contributions and his continuous growth mindset. He never stops learning and consistently uplifts the entire team with his positive energy.
